title: paraš-
full:
From {{inh|xsa|sem-wes-pro|*paraš-}}. A state form of {{m|xsa|𐩰𐩧𐩪𐩣|tr=frs¹m|t=horse; horseman}}.

The underlying lexeme is cognate with {{cog|ar|فَرَس|t=horse, mare}} and {{cog|gez|ፈረስ|tr=färäs|t=horse}}. Compare Ḥaḍramitic {{m|xhd|𐩱𐩰𐩧𐩪|tr=ʾfrs¹|t=cavalry}} and Yemeni Arabic {{m|ar|فَرَس|t=mare}}.
